cards.title: Reading the map
items: Nodes are the seven subsystem groups of the 24-component register; tags count review-derived requirements and tasks
Edge labels count cross-layer dependency edges declared in the design register
Aggregates (L4→L1/L2/L0, L3→L0/L1, L2→L0, L5→L0, L6→L0/L2/L4) are omitted here — the full map is design/diagrams/layer-map.html

cards.title: Governance workstreams (outside the nodes)
items: T-01..T-02: ADR-005 licence decision + no-import rule for vcast-findings assets (P0)
T-03: SRS change request — TOOL-EXE-040 timeout distinct from fail (P0)
T-04/T-05: identity-model and platform-order decisions; T-14 is blocked by T-04

cards.title: Where the work concentrates
items: L1 Comprehension carries the largest share: LinkPlan, ing context, S1 schema mandates, ranges, eligibility gate
L4 Evidence: coverage completeness state, MC/DC probes + corpus, verdict denominators
P0 items gate WP-BLD-01/WP-EXH-01; all items await the SRS/plan change process
